title: GET /requests/{requestId} Response Schema
description: Returns the complete MMR object with all associated details

requestId.description: Unique, stable identifier for the MMR record across the entire platform

instructionId.description: Unique identifier of the approved MMI under which this request was created

accountId.description: Unique identifier for the account from which or to which funds will move

railType.description: Payment rail through which funds are transferred

amount.description: The monetary value of the transfer to be executed (up to 2 decimal places)

unitType.description: Unit type for the amount (Dollar or Percent)

percent.description: Percentage value when unitType is Percent

purpose.description: Purpose or description of the money movement

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the money movement request

reason.description: The reason code for this request (for IRA accounts). May be null for non-IRA accounts

schedule.description: Schedule information for the money movement request

PaymentDate.description: For One-Time payments, the date on which the transfer is scheduled to be initiated. Null for periodic schedules

enum: Last Business Day of the Month
Frequency.description: For Periodic payments, defines how often the money movement occurs. Null for one-time schedules

StartDate.description: For Periodic payments, the first effective date from which transfers become active. Null for one-time schedules

EndDate.description: For Periodic payments, the date after which no further transfers should be executed. May be null for open-ended schedules

NextDate.description: For Periodic payments, the next upcoming payment date. Maintained dynamically by the system after each execution

version.description: Version number for optimistic concurrency control

createdDate.description: Timestamp when the record was first created in the system

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user, system, or process that created the record

modifiedDate.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the record

modifiedBy.description: Identifier of the user, system, or process that last modified the record
